model_axis.rule: Every eligible experiment that varies neuron.model must record the model id and complete NeuronConfig in its execution contract. Izhikevich remains the canonical default; LIF is an optional treatment arm and requires a model-specific hypothesis when inferential claims compare models.

historical_v1.note: The 1000-tick free-running exact-trajectory comparison is retained unchanged. V2 does not overwrite it and does not reinterpret its 0/3 result as a pass.

observations: Izhikevich local one-step transition conformance passed at errors far below 1e-8 while the long free-running trajectory amplified ~1e-10 differences into later spike-time divergence.
LIF with refractory_ticks=0 matched Brian2 exactly.
For nonzero LIF refractory settings at dt=1 ms, diagnostic mapping was MHRN refractory_ticks n -> Brian2 refractory (n+1) ms for n=1..3.

lif_refractory_secondary_endpoints.mapping_rule: brian2_refractory_ms = native_refractory_ticks + 1 at dt_ms=1.0 for native values 1..3

confirmatory_validation.success_rule: H-EVAL-006-A and H-EVAL-006-B require all three confirmatory seeds to satisfy every primary endpoint. H-EVAL-006-C is supported only if all three declared nonzero refractory mappings satisfy both equality endpoints in all three confirmatory seeds.
confirmatory_validation.retry_rule: No parameter, tolerance, mapping, seed or sample-count changes are permitted after confirmatory execution. A failure remains a DATA result and requires a separately versioned protocol.

homeostasis_operating_envelope.interpretation: The mechanism reached the 10 Hz target without actuator saturation for the listed diagnostic currents. At current 30 the +10 mV actuator bound saturated and the target was not reachable. This is an operating-envelope statement for the declared configuration, not a universal current threshold across neuron models.

evidence_policy.interpretation_limit: Brian2 is an external software reference implementation, not an independently authored replication of the MHRN study. A green run closes reference-conformance for this protocol but does not by itself satisfy an independent-replication maturity criterion.
